name: tiktok-live-game-platform
description: A TikTok LIVE game platform hosting fifty independent games (incl. TEAM ARENA with thirty-three team, word-duel and duel formats, and the ARCADE set: Hangman, Emoji Decoder, Missing Vowels, Odd One Out, Math Blitz, Secret Code, Word Rush, Name Them All, Peekaboo, Tic Tac Tactics, Connect 4 Tactics, Maze Runner, Snake Arena, Higher or Lower, This or That, Simon Says, Treasure Grid) behind one game-selector screen, each reading real audience chat as guesses. Word games can be played in English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu (Malaysia) or any mix.
